messages:
maria.dev: Heads-up — planning a staged key rotation for KEK v3 -> v4 next week. Goal: automatic rotate for non-critical buckets, manual rewrap for sensitive datasets. Need RBAC gating, audit hooks, and a fallback plan. TL;DR: 1) Canary 5% traffic, 2) Gradual 25/50/100 waves, 3) Immediate rollback via rewrap endpoint. Thoughts? :eyes:

jonathan.s: +1 on canary. question: how do we handle embedding caches and on-disk ciphertext headers? if header version changes, older runtimes must still be able to read until rollout complete.

maria.dev: Good call. Plan is to keep ciphertext header version backward-compatible: header includes kek_version and algorithm. New decryptors accept both v3 and v4. Rewrap API will write new header but preserve old fields for a grace window.

lina-sec: Audit requirements: every rewrap must produce an audit event with these fields: principal, source_kek, target_kek, key_id, object_id, time, action=rewrap, request_id. Retention 7y for enterprise customers. Also log whether operation was automatic or manual.

adeel-platform: SLO implications: rewrap is IO-heavy. We should throttle concurrent rewrap jobs per region and track queue depth. Suggest config: max_concurrent_rewraps=50, per-tenant cap=5, backoff on 429s. Also surface rewrap progress in Console.

jonathan.s: For IAM, we'll need an attestation role for the rewrap worker with narrowly-scoped permissions. Example policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncryptFrom","kms:ReEncryptTo"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-*/*"}
  ]
}
```

maria.dev: Nice. Add an allow for Cloud KMS / Azure equivalents in our multi-cloud abstractions. We'll have a feature flag to gate which key provider is used in canary.

lina-sec: Also ensure audit logs are tamper-evident — include a hash chain ID and push to immutable store (logs:write:immutable). We should include a verification job daily.

sec-bot: Reminder: rotation playbook link: https://redwood.internal/docs/sec/key-rotation-playbook — run preflight checks: RBAC matrix, service-account-sanity, canary-rollback-sim. :white_check_mark:

adeel-platform: Canary rollout schedule proposal: day 0: dry-run on staging, day 1: 5% non-sensitive, day 2: 25%, day 3: 50%, day 5: full, day 7: deprecate v3 for new writes but continue reads until day 30. Manual rewrap window open until day 45.

jonathan.s: What about emergency rollback? If rewrap causes failures, can we auto-fallback to v3 by rewriting keystates? We need idempotent revert operation and ability to pause all automatic rewraps globally.

maria.dev: Yes: rewrap workers will persist a pre-rewrap snapshot of object metadata and a reversible map. We'll add a global feature-flag toggle to pause auto rewraps and an emergency endpoint: `POST /internal/rewraps/rollback` with `dry_run=true` option. Example curl: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://api.redwood.internal/internal/rewraps/rollback \
  -d '{"kek_from":"v4","kek_to":"v3","scope":"canary"}'
```

lina-sec: For compliance reviews, attach audit evidence for any rollback: who triggered it, reason, and a link to the verification job output.

adeel-platform: We should also surface estimated CPU/GPU and duration per rewrap batch. Add metric names: `rewrap.batch.duration`, `rewrap.batch.failures`, `rewrap.concurrency`. Hook to alerts: >5% failure rate for 10m -> pager.

maria.dev: Agree. Let's document RBAC matrix: service-account for rewrap worker, admin role for manual rewrap, auditor role read-only on audit logs, and ops role to pause rollouts. I'll draft and post.

jonathan.s: One more thing: encrypted index formats (search indexes) — we must avoid double-encrypting tokens used by embeddings. Suggest a preflight test that picks 100 random objects, rewraps them in a canary, and validates hash equality and query results.

maria.dev: Good. Action items: @jonathan.s to add IAM policy examples for GCP/Azure, @lina-sec to list audit event schema + retention note, @adeel-platform to implement throttling config and metrics, I'll write runbook + feature-flag. Plan to start dry-run Tue 09:00 PST.

deploy-bot: deploy: rewrap-worker:v4 -> staging started by maria.dev at 1729991500 :rocket: ```deploy-log snippet: START rewrap-worker:v4 image pull...```

sec-bot: Note: filing a vuln-triage ticket if we detect anomalous decrypt failures during canary. Ticket template: projects/Sec/triage/rewrap-canary-failures.

maria.dev: Thanks all. I'll send the runbook link and timeline in #eng-security later today. :lock:
